by
  -- Step 1: Show that a + ⨆ i, f i is an upper bound for {a + f i | i ∈ ι}
  have h1 : ∀ i, a + f i ≤ a + ⨆ i, f i := by
    intro i
    exact add_le_add_right (le_ciSup f hf) a
  -- Step 2: Show that {a + f i | i ∈ ι} is bounded above
  have h2 : BddAbove (Set.range (fun i => a + f i)) := by
    apply BddAbove.add_left
    exact hf
  -- Step 3: Apply ciSup_add_le_ciSup_add_ciSup to get that ⨆ i, a + f i ≤ a + ⨆ i, f i
  have h3 : ⨆ i, a + f i ≤ a + ⨆ i, f i := by
    apply ciSup_add_le_ciSup_add_ciSup
    exact hf
    exact h2
  -- Step 4: Show the reverse inequality using add_le_ciSup
  have h4 : a + ⨆ i, f i ≤ ⨆ i, a + f i := by
    apply add_le_ciSup
    intro i
    exact add_le_add_left (le_ciSup f hf) a
  -- Step 5: Combine both inequalities to conclude equality
  calc
    a + ⨆ i, f i ≤ ⨆ i, a + f i := h4
    ⨆ i, a + f i ≤ a + ⨆ i, f i := h3
  hence a + ⨆ i, f i = ⨆ i, a + f i by linarith
